title: useChat sends a stale value in DefaultChatTransport body after React state changes
symptoms: Server always receives the first render value from transport body
Changing a model or agent selector in the UI has no effect on requests
Passing body as a function still sends the old value
cause: useChat creates its Chat instance once and kept the transport from the first render, so values captured in transport body never updated. The fix landed in July 2026 (PR 16546).
fix: Upgrade @ai-sdk/react to 3.0.223 or later on the ai 6 line, or 4.0.12 or later on the ai 7 line. On ai 5, which has no fix, pass per request data in the sendMessage options instead of the transport.
affected: @ai-sdk/react before 3.0.223 (ai 6 line) and before 4.0.12 (ai 7 line); the ai 5 line has no fix
